Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent cinematic spacecraft sprite for StarChain, enemy tier 4 "云雀轻型飞碟". Preferred canvas 1536x1024.
Primary request: ONE SMALL FLATTENED OBLATE SAUCER SPACECRAFT. The defining silhouette is a shallow elliptical disc with one small centered dome, similar to a compact flying saucer. Low-profile, low-tier scout craft. It has one continuous very thin violet-purple luminous line around the disc rim. Sparse smooth silver armor plates on the upper disc, graphite black machinery underneath. Only a few panels, clean simple readable structure, not densely weaponized.
Orientation: front LEFT, propulsion RIGHT. At the forward LEFT rim a tiny cyan-violet optical sensor and a subtle silver notch establish the nose. Three SMALL recessed aft-facing thruster apertures are arranged across the visible dark underside toward the RIGHT rear edge; short restrained violet glows only, no long exhaust. No cockpit windshield, no human occupant.
Composition: full shallow disc in horizontal three-quarter view from slightly above, allowing a modest sliver of underside to be visible. Major axis nearly horizontal. A compact disc with a SINGLE modest central dome, no protruding wings, fins, arms or legs. Entire spacecraft and any glow must fit in the CENTRAL 74 percent of canvas width and central 65 percent of canvas height, comfortably more than 8 percent clear transparent margins on every side. Do not crop. One isolated spacecraft only.
Input image role: supplied reference is ONLY for cinematic realistic silver/graphite materials, violet-blue emissive details and bright neutral top-left studio key light; NEVER copy its long fighter silhouette or big engines.
Style: premium cinematic realistic hard-surface game spacecraft, precise believable seams, a few silver armor plates with subtle light scratches, graphite underside, faint violet rim light. Crisp material rendering matching the reference.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA alpha. Clean isolated edges, no opaque black background, no studio backdrop, no ground, no cast shadow or atmosphere.
Avoid: sphere, spherical probe, hollow ring or torus, winged fighter, long fuselage, pointed airplane shape, enormous battleship, weapon barrels, sea vessels, land vehicles, humans, humanoid robot, multiple ships, text, letters, numbers, watermarks, UI, framing, beams, laser fire, long exhaust, outer ambient fog or hazy halo.
